data.name: AboutCredit
data.value: Based on DCS-SimpleRadio Standalone by Ciribob and contributors (GPL-3.0)

data.name: AboutDescription
data.value: Digital radio voice communication with realistic radio effects. Connect to an EasyRadioLink server, tune the radio and talk to everybody on the same frequency.

data.name: AboutQuickStart1
data.value: Choose your microphone and speakers on the Radio tab and check them with Audio Preview.

data.name: AboutQuickStart2
data.value: Enter your name and the server address (and the password, if the server has one), then click Connect.

data.name: AboutQuickStart3
data.value: The radio opens. Turn the tuning knob (or use the mouse wheel, the arrow keys, ▲ / ▼ and STEP) to set the frequency - or double-click the display and type it.

data.name: AboutQuickStart4
data.value: Set a Push-To-Talk key on the Controls tab and hold it to talk. Everybody tuned to the same frequency hears you.

data.name: AboutTipAudio
data.value: Speaker boost makes up for the volume the radio effects take away - lower it if the audio distorts. Pick a preview sound to hear yourself through that radio.

data.name: AboutTipInputDevices
data.value: Controller not detected? Enable "Allow more controller input devices" under Settings > Advanced settings and restart EasyRadioLink.

data.name: AboutTipRadioPanel
data.value: Radio: the underlined digit is the one the knob changes - STEP (or the arrow keys Left / Right) chooses 1 kHz to 100 MHz. Drag the bottom-right corner to resize the radio.

data.name: AdvancedSettingsSubtitle
data.value: Audio processing, voice activation details, recording, effect details, controllers, profiles

data.name: AllowTransmissionsRecord
data.value: Allow others to record my transmissions

data.name: AllowXInputController
data.value: Allow XInput controllers, e.g. Xbox controllers (restart required)

data.name: AmbientEffectToggle
data.value: Play the background sounds of other users

data.name: AmbientEffectVolume
data.value: Volume of other users' background sounds

data.name: BtnTrustNewIdentity
data.value: Connect anyway and trust the new identity

data.name: ClientListCount
data.value: {0} user(s) connected. Muting a user only affects what you hear.

data.name: ControlsHint
data.value: Click Set and press a key or a controller button. A modifier is an optional second button that has to be held as well. Bindings are saved in the current profile.

data.name: DisallowedAudioTone
data.value: Record a tone instead of users who don't allow recording

data.name: ExpandInputDevices
data.value: Allow more controller input devices (restart required)

data.name: FavTitle
data.value: Saved servers appear in the favourites list on the Radio tab. Drag rows to reorder them, double-click a cell to edit it and use the flag column to choose the default server.

data.name: IncomingAudioAGCMaxDBToolTip
data.value: How much quiet voices are boosted. Recommended: 40 dB

data.name: IncomingAudioAGCTargetLevelToolTip
data.value: How loud incoming voices are made. Recommended: 14000 - 20000

data.name: MsgBoxAdminText
data.value:
EasyRadioLink does not need administrator rights. Only enable this if your keys or controller buttons are not detected while a program that runs as administrator has the focus.
Restart EasyRadioLink for the change to take effect.
Run EasyRadioLink as administrator?

data.name: MsgBoxAudioErrorHeading
data.value: The audio devices could not be started

data.name: MsgBoxAudioStartFailedText
data.value:
Try a different audio device and check the Windows privacy settings for the microphone.
Details are in the log file in {0}

data.name: MsgBoxAuthFailedText
data.value:
The server {0} rejected the password.
Check the password and connect again. Leave the password empty for servers without a password.

data.name: MsgBoxIdentityChangedHeading
data.value: The identity of this server has changed

data.name: MsgBoxIdentityChangedText
MsgBoxIdentityUnknownHeading
data.value: The saved identity of this server is unreadable

data.name: MsgBoxIdentityUnknownText
MsgBoxIdentityCheckFailedHeading
data.value: The identity of the server could not be checked

data.name: MsgBoxIdentityCheckFailedText
MsgBoxConnectFailedHeading
data.value: Could not connect to the server

data.name: MsgBoxConnectFailedText
data.value:
No EasyRadioLink server answered at {0}.
Check the address and the port (default {1}), that the server is running and that no firewall blocks TCP and UDP on that port.

data.name: MsgBoxErrorInputText
data.value: The default profile can't be deleted.

data.name: MsgBoxErrorRenameText
data.value: The default profile can't be renamed.

data.name: MsgBoxFavSaveFailedText
data.value: The favourite servers could not be saved. The log file has the details.

data.name: MsgBoxInvalidIPHeading
data.value: The server address could not be resolved

data.name: MsgBoxInvalidIPText
data.value:
"{0}" is not a valid host name or IP address.
Enter the host name or IP address of the server, optionally followed by :port (default port {1}), e.g. 192.168.1.20:5010.

data.name: MsgBoxInvalidServerText
data.value:
{0} accepted the connection but did not complete the EasyRadioLink handshake.
Check the address and the port (default {1}). Servers older than EasyRadioLink 1.1 can't be used with this client.

data.name: MsgBoxMicPassthru
data.value: Mic output and speakers are the same device

data.name: MsgBoxMicPassthruText
data.value:
Mic output is meant for recording or streaming, not as a side tone - you would hear yourself with a delay.
Select "None (no mic output)" or a different device as mic output.

data.name: MsgBoxNotVisibleText
data.value: The EasyRadioLink window was outside the visible screen area (for example after a monitor change). Its position has been reset.

data.name: MsgBoxRadioPanelNotVisibleText
data.value: The radio was outside the visible screen area (for example after a monitor change). Its position has been reset.

data.name: MsgBoxRescanText
data.value: Newly connected controllers and input devices can be used now.

data.name: MsgBoxRestartExpandText
data.value:
Restart EasyRadioLink for this setting to take effect.
This allows almost any DirectInput device (except a mouse) to be used as input, but it may cause problems with the detection of other devices. Only turn it on if your controller is not detected otherwise.

data.name: MsgBoxRestartXInputText
data.value: Restart EasyRadioLink for this setting to take effect.

data.name: MsgBoxServerMismatchHeading
data.value: This server can't be used with this client

data.name: MsgBoxServerMismatchText
PerRadioModelEffects
data.value: Radio sound of the band (CB, PMR, airband, ...)

data.name: ProfileHint
data.value: A profile holds your key bindings (Controls tab) and the radio settings: the radio sounds and effects, the background sound, the push-to-talk delays, rotary tuning and the radio balance. All other settings apply to every profile.

data.name: RadioPanelTaskbarItem
data.value: Hide the radio from the taskbar

data.name: RadioSoundEffectsClipping
data.value: Clipping (needs a radio effect strength above 0%)

data.name: RadioSoundsProfileNotice
data.value: These settings belong to the profile "{0}" (Advanced settings > Profiles).

data.name: ResetRadioPanel
data.value: Reset the position and size of the radio

data.name: ServerInfoHint
data.value: Settings of the connected server that affect your radio.

data.name: ShowTransmitterName
data.value: Show who is transmitting (if the server allows it)

data.name: SrvBusyChannelLockout
data.value: One speaker per frequency (busy channel lockout)

data.name: SrvServerIdentityHint
data.value: The connection is encrypted. EasyRadioLink remembers this fingerprint for the server and warns you before connecting if it ever changes. Compare it with the fingerprint your server admin shares.

data.name: SrvTunedClientCount
data.value: Show the number of users on a frequency

data.name: ToolTipAllowRecording
data.value: Other users can only record your voice if this is on. The setting is sent to the server when you connect.

data.name: ToolTipAmbientEffect
data.value: Other users can mix a background sound (jet, prop, helicopter) into their transmissions

data.name: ToolTipAutoOpenRadioPanel
data.value: Shows the radio automatically after connecting to a server

data.name: ToolTipBackgroundRadioNoise
data.value: Static behind received voices, depending on the frequency. The static levels are under Advanced settings > Radio Effect Details.

data.name: ToolTipBackgroundSound
data.value: A background sound mixed into your transmissions, e.g. an engine. Everybody who hears you hears it too.

data.name: ToolTipClientListMute
data.value: Mute or unmute this user for you - the others still hear them

data.name: ToolTipClientListRecording
data.value: Whether the user allows others to record their transmissions

data.name: ToolTipDisplayName
data.value: Your name - shown to other users and in the server's user list

data.name: ToolTipFavAdd
data.value: Add this server to the favourites

data.name: ToolTipFavDefault
data.value: Make this the default server (filled in at start-up if the last server used is not a favourite)

data.name: ToolTipFavouritePicker
data.value: Pick a saved server (fills in the address and the password)

data.name: ToolTipFmTone
data.value: The quiet tone heard on FM radios while receiving

data.name: ToolTipHFNoiseGainDB
data.value: Extra static for frequencies below 30 MHz (e.g. CB and HF radios)

data.name: ToolTipMicOutput
data.value: Optional: also sends your microphone to this device, e.g. for streaming or recording. This is not a side tone - don't select your speakers here.

data.name: ToolTipNoMicL1
data.value: No valid microphone is available - others will not be able to hear you.

data.name: ToolTipNoMicL2
data.value: You can still listen to the radio, but you can't transmit.

data.name: ToolTipPerRadioModelEffects
data.value: Transmissions sound like the radio of their band (CB, PMR, airband, ...). Off: every transmission uses the standard sound.

data.name: ToolTipPreviewModel
data.value: Radio sound used by Audio Preview - hear yourself through that radio

data.name: ToolTipRadioRxSquelchTail
data.value: Plays a short burst of static when a received AM or FM transmission ends, like a CB radio

data.name: ToolTipRecordQuality
data.value: The quality can only be changed while recording is off

data.name: ToolTipResetRadioPanel
data.value: Moves the radio back to its default position and size (an open radio is closed)

data.name: ToolTipRotaryIncrement
data.value: Tuning (knob, ▲ / ▼, keys) changes only the underlined digit and rolls over from 9 to 0 instead of carrying into the next digit

data.name: ToolTipServerAddress
data.value: Host name or IP address of the server, optionally followed by :port (default port 5010)

data.name: ToolTipServerPassword
data.value: Only needed if the server is password protected. The password is sent over the encrypted connection, after the server's identity was checked.

data.name: ToolTipSoundRxEnd
data.value: Played when a transmission you receive ends

data.name: ToolTipSoundRxStart
data.value: Played when a transmission you receive starts

data.name: ToolTipSoundTxEnd
data.value: Played on your speakers when you stop transmitting. The others hear the sound they chose for "When someone stops talking".

data.name: ToolTipSoundTxStart
data.value: Played on your speakers when you start transmitting. The others hear the sound they chose for "When someone starts talking".

data.name: ToolTipVoiceDistortion
data.value: Degrades the voices you receive (and your Audio Preview): narrower sound, overdrive, lo-fi crunch and fading; above 50% also crackle and short dropouts (digital: breakup). 0% = clean voice, 35% = rough but easy to understand, 100% = badly broken reception. Acts on the whole received voice at any radio effect strength; off only while the radio effect strength is 0%

data.name: ToolTipVOXEnabled
data.value: Transmits while you speak - no Push-To-Talk needed

data.name: ToolTipVOXSensitivity
data.value: The higher the sensitivity the less likely speech is missed, but the higher the chance that noise starts a transmission

data.name: ToolTipVOXThreshold
data.value: Minimum loudness that counts as speech

data.name: AboutTipBands
data.value: The frequency decides everything else: 26.965 - 27.405 MHz is CB (AM), 446.000 - 446.200 MHz is PMR (FM), 108 - 137 MHz is airband (AM), 900 MHz and above is digital, and so on. Everybody on the same frequency uses the same mode and radio sound.

data.name: ToolTipRadioBalance
data.value: Plays the radio on the left, on the right or on both sides of your speakers / headphones

data.name: ToolTipRadioDisplay
data.value: Double-click (or press Enter) to type a frequency. Mouse wheel or arrow keys Up / Down: tune. Left / Right: tuning step.

data.name: ToolTipStep
data.value: Tuning step: 1 kHz, 10 kHz, 100 kHz, 1 MHz, 10 MHz or 100 MHz (the underlined digit)

data.name: ToolTipTuningKnob
data.value: Tuning knob: drag it round or use the mouse wheel - one click is one step

data.name: ToolTipRadioBusy
data.value: Busy: another station is transmitting on this frequency. Push-to-talk is refused while it is busy - release it and press again when the frequency is free.
